fluff.overview: The LCAF fields conventional infantry that benefit from the Commonwealth's deep industrial base, equipping even garrison formations with reliable, well-maintained weapons and transport. Jump infantry use thruster backpacks to leap across obstacles and reposition rapidly on the battlefield, trading platoon size for the tactical mobility to seize or defend terrain that foot troops cannot reach quickly. Armed with assault rifles and infantry-portable long-range missile launchers, these platoons can engage armored targets at distances well beyond normal infantry weapon range, providing indirect fire support to the formation.
